claim_scope: Every n>=17, labeled alphabets of sizes 3 and 4, unrestricted codes with distances exactly from the set {2,4}; unique shell representation and (q(q-1))^n distinct maxima.
integrity: All-length conclusion follows from a mathematical equality-case argument; finite evidence is corroborative. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uses structural inequalities from a publicly posted preprint for unrestricted quaternary prescribed-distance codes.
No classification is claimed for n<=16, alphabets of other sizes, or alternative distance sets.
Finite programs test constructions and strict bounds, not exhaustive large-length codebook uniqueness.
Unindexed prior equality-case derivations remain a possible novelty risk.
title: Rigidity and exact enumeration of maximum ternary and quaternary two-distance codes
